principle: Do not merge stores by table similarity. Preserve active behavior until Product/Stock/Order identity and lifecycle are migrated with evidence.

facts: shop.catalog reads seller_products joined to seller_profiles.
shop.order.create calls shop_create_order and creates seller_orders.
Cart product IDs are seller_products.id values.
Seller product writes are owner-scoped by seller_user_id.
Seller order status is managed in seller_orders.
market.view and market.* commands use the normalized market_* model.
Checkout reserves warehouse stock and creates a Finance invoice.
Fulfillment converts reserved stock to shipment movement.

market.owner: owner_user_id + organization_id (+ owner_context_id in later schema)

Product.safeCandidateMatch: same owner_user_id/seller_user_id + normalized SKU only; SKU alone is ambiguous

market.semantics: quantity and reserved are separate; mutations create movement records

seller.semantics: checkout immediately decrements stock_qty; no warehouse reservation or stock movement ledger in seller flow

Stock.requiredTargetInvariant: available = quantity - reserved; reservations and shipments must be traceable and reversible

market.stockEffect: increase market_stock.reserved; no immediate quantity decrement

seller.finance: no Finance invoice creation in shop_create_order
seller.sellerGrouping: cart is split into one seller_order per seller

market.fulfillmentEffect: quantity -= qty; reserved -= qty; shipment movement

UsedParts.relation: Separate resale/listing aggregate; do not force into new-parts Product/Stock migration merely to reduce tables.

requiredSemantics: Stable cross-model Product identity or explicit mapping table before writer migration.
Organization/seller ownership mapping must be explicit.
Warehouse stock, reserved quantity and movement/audit semantics must survive migration.
Order status mapping must be explicit and lossless; cancelled/returned compensation cannot be guessed.
Finance invoice/payment linkage must be preserved for target checkout.
Current #/parts seller_* behavior remains operational until replacement proves parity.
forbiddenShortcuts: Do not copy seller_products into market_products by SKU alone.
Do not sum or overwrite stock without warehouse/allocation policy.
Do not translate seller cancelled/returned directly to market completed/reserved.
Do not switch #/parts to market_* before cart/checkout/order/history regression passes.
Do not delete seller_* while external/current routes still read or write it.

nextEvidence: Measure exact owner+SKU overlap, owner/SKU ambiguity and stock divergence.
Measure active route traffic/readers if runtime telemetry is available.
Define product identity mapping and order lifecycle translation only after data distribution is known.
